about_the_game:
A bullet hell shmup where time is on your side! Slow, stop, and rewind time to escape sticky situations, and punish your foes with the mighty Chain Counter!

In the distant, distant future, a lone city stands in a ruined world, ruled by a seemingly-immortal empress for over a thousand years. As the masses suffer under her iron fist, two heroes / idiot furballs start a desperate battle for liberation, armed with the Chronal Chain, a powerful artifact which can manipulate time itself.

Experience a fully voiced story as you weave your way through 5 intricately patterned stages, with 4 difficulty levels to provide the right amount of challenge for all players! You won't have to take this challenge on all at once: time travel lets you practice sections at your own pace, and easily pick up where you left off!
